params.name: docRef
params.description: Reference number of a document opened via Open document/Create document/Append document; if omitted, reads from the serial port or document opened via SET CHANNEL instead.

params.name: receiveVar
params.description: Variable receiving the characters read; its type must match the type used by the corresponding SEND PACKET call.

params.name: stopChar
params.description: String at which to stop reading; the stop string itself is not included in receiveVar.

overloads.semanticRole: Reads characters from the serial port or document until the stopChar string is encountered (or, if not found, until end of document / until the reception is interrupted or times out on a serial port).

params.name: docRef
params.description: Reference number of a document opened via Open document/Create document/Append document; if omitted, reads from the serial port or document opened via SET CHANNEL instead.

params.name: receiveVar
params.description: Variable receiving the characters read; its type must match the type used by the corresponding SEND PACKET call.

params.name: numBytes
params.description: Exact number of bytes to read into receiveVar.

overloads.semanticRole: Reads exactly numBytes bytes/characters from the serial port or document into receiveVar.

constraints: When the received packet is a BLOB, it is returned unmodified regardless of any USE CHARACTER SET setting.

When the received packet is Text, RECEIVE PACKET detects and strips a leading Byte Order Mark if the current character set is Unicode (UTF-8/16/32), switching to the BOM's encoding instead of the current character set.

Reading a document with docRef always starts at the beginning on the first call and resumes after the last byte read on subsequent calls; Get document position / SET DOCUMENT POSITION can be used to inspect or change that position.
Reading past end-of-file returns the data read so far with OK set to 1; the following call then returns an empty string with OK set to 0.

The read interrupts on Ctrl-Alt-Shift (Windows) / Command-Option-Shift (macOS), raising error -9994, catchable via an ON ERR CALL method (mainly relevant when reading a serial port, since a document read without a stopChar match simply stops at EOF).
